Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz.

Please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Who will you join?

Group Compliance - Investigations
About the role

Allianz Group Compliance is evolving its investigations function toward a more integrated, increasingly technology- and AI-enabled operating model. We are at the beginning of that journey. The primary requirement for this role remains hands-on experience in complex investigations. In addition, the role holder will help shape how the function adopts investigative technology and AI - pragmatically, and in a responsible, human-led way. We welcome candidates from an investigations, IT-forensics or legal-tech background who combine strong investigative capability with a genuine interest in developing this area.

How can you make an impact?

As an Investigator / Investigation Counsel, your responsibilities will include:

Investigations

- Member of the rapid-reaction task force to lead investigations on ad hoc Compliance issues
- Assess, prioritize, execute and lead complex compliance investigations
- Collaborate with Regions / Global Lines / other entities on delegated investigations
- Provide expert guidance and support to Compliance Officers at local, regional and global levels
- Monitor, follow-up and escalate issues as necessary, ensuring resolution and compliance
- Make effective use of investigative technology and, as it is introduced, AI-enabled methods (e.g. e-discovery, data analytics) to work efficiently and at scale, keeping human judgment at the centre
- Continuously enhance and share insights and lessons learned

Governance

- Develop and implement governance frameworks to support effective investigation processes
Review and update policies related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to ensure alignment with industry standards
Contribute to the further development of the investigations operating model, including the responsible integration of technology and AI as the setup matures  *  Provide guidance on governance issues related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to enhance organizational integrity

Awareness

- Contribute to initiatives aimed at elevating the awareness and effectiveness of the Whistleblowing program

Reporting

- Ensure comprehensive and accurate data entry into the Compliance Case Management Tool (CCMT)
- Develop and present detailed reports and presentations on Compliance investigations and related topics to senior management
- Analyze case data and CCMT usage to identify trends, providing strategic insights and reports where required
- Prepare responses to media requests and provide input to Sustainability reports, Audits and other similar / related information requests

Integrity Committee

- Fulfill obligations under the Integrity Committee Terms of Reference (both ad hoc and standing committees)
- Prepare and present Integrity Committee reports and minutes

What are you made of?

Minimum Qualifications

- Solid experience (3+ years) and proven competence in conducting and, increasingly, leading complex investigations effectively and efficiently, ideally with international exposure
- Strong expertise in remediation and mitigation measures in an international and multicultural environment
- Exceptional ability to communicate clearly and constructively with all levels, including senior management, within a multicultural organization
- Proven ability to learn, acquire and apply new knowledge and skills in digital and investigative methodologies, laws and regulations

Preferred Qualifications

- In-depth knowledge of the insurance business is an advantage
- Some practical, operational experience with investigative technology - e.g. e-discovery, data analytics, IT forensics or legal-tech tools - whether gained as an investigator, IT-forensics specialist or legal-technology professional
- Interest in helping build an AI-enabled investigation capability, with a pragmatic and responsible view of where technology adds real value;
- Strong communication and report-writing skills (fluent English required; additional languages a plus)
- Results-driven team player
- Willingness to work across time zones and travel internationally
- Strategic and innovative approach to working in a governance function
- High level of confidentiality and discretion
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified

And there is much more: Allianz SE Benefits

jobs.occupation: Team Lead for Function Controlling (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Controlling)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Team Lead for Function Controlling (f/m/d) within the SE FIN GS BC SO organisation, you will be at the forefront of acting as business partner for SE GS Solution Functions. Your role will involve driving financial performance and supporting strategic decision-making across the Solution organization of SE GS. Your primary focus will be on optimizing cost controlling processes by implementing AI and Dash solutions, ensuring effective budget planning, and providing insightful analysis of forecasts and actuals. You will lead a global team, coaching and developing team members to achieve their full potential.
Each day, your leadership will strengthen financial performance and enhance accountability across all functions of Solution business.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the financial performance management of cost centres by preparing, consolidating, and analysing forecasts, budgets, and monthly closings
* Act as a business partner by conducting reasonable analyses of key financial drivers for cost centres, delivering clear financial reports that include deviation analyses and actionable performance insights
* Implement and oversee standardized processes and automation initiatives, leverage AI where applicable to streamline operations.
* Develop and implement dashboards that provide real-time insights into cost centre performance and manpower utilization
* Collaborate with various functions to address complex setup topics, accounting questions, and reporting issues, ensuring reliable financial steering and alignment with organizational goals

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
* Extensive experience in financial controlling, FP&A, budgeting, and corporate finance within a complex business environment
* Proven leadership capabilities in developing and managing teams of experienced finance professionals
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business decisions
* Excellent knowledge of SAP applications, financial reporting, internal controls, and process improvement within a global matrix organization
* Fluent English communication skills; German is beneficial for collaboration within the local business environment 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Tesla is seeking highly motivated engineering students who thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to apply electrical concepts to real world projects. Our team drives collaboration with many engineering groups - team players only. Tesla moves quickly, so being self-motivated and disciplined is critical. You must be passionate, but direction changes quickly, so you must also be resilient. As an intern you will work directly with full-time engineers to design, prototype, test and launch new parts and processes to improve our batteries. Our projects include advanced cooling systems, cell interfaces and high voltage distribution. Every day we push the boundaries of what is possible for energy storage in our vehicles, demanding extreme attention to details and the highest standard of performance, quality and manufacturability.

What You’ll Do

- Design new battery electrical components that improve product metrics (performance, cost, mass)
- Own basic testing and analysis; support advanced testing and analysis
- Develop various test setups and fixtures to validate battery components
- Create schematics and layouts for complex circuits and assemblies
- Root cause test failures and process/manufacturing issues
- Collaborate with other teams inside Tesla (manufacturing, testing, NPI, supply chain, etc.)

- Currently working towards a BS, MS, or advanced degree in a relevant engineering program such as Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field

- Demonstrated hands-on abilities (e.g. machine shop skills, technical hobbies/academic projects, etc.) - Experience with student Formula Vehicle, Solar Car, etc. is a plus

- Strong knowledge of tolerance analysis, applying GD&T, finite element analysis (FEA), and basic thermal models
- Detail-oriented personality with top-tier documentation and reporting skills
- Fluency in English, German is a plus

Tesla's Vehicle and Powertrain Engineering teams in Berlin are looking for Team Project Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone of the organization. You will work closely with engineering managers, HR, and factory stakeholders to support our engineers in building the world's best vehicles.The Vehicle and Powertrain Design Engineering teams in Europe are developing and launching new vehicle programs and technology for Tesla’s global products and working closely with Gigafactory Berlin and the local and global test engineering teams.This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, works highly organized, takes ownership without being asked, and brings structure to ambiguity.

What You’ll Do

- Own the day-to-day workplace experience for the Vehicle Engineering team — from managing seating and workwear budgets to organizing team events and acting as the main liaison with facilities. Track and act on Pulse Survey feedback, coordinate anniversary recognition, and ensure the team has a well-organized, engaging place to work.

- Serve as the operational bridge between Design Engineering and Gigafactory Berlin — managing non-technical workflows, service agreements, and team administration. Coordinate executive visits, own the non-technical agenda for weekly team meetings, and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly across travel, PTO, and site housekeeping.

- Perform additional responsibilities in alignment with Design Engineering management in daily operations assigned to meet business needs

What You’ll Bring

jobs.occupation: Doctoral researcher (m/f/d) (75 %) (Agrarwissenschaftler/in / Agrarökonom/in)
jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Agrartechnik und Bioökonomie e.V.
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

To support Economics of Technologies in Agriculture in the Technology Assessment Department we are seeking, at the earliest possible date a

Doctoral researcher (m/f/d) (75 %)

for the research area

„Economic analysis of innovative fenland use“

The economic analysis includes various lines of utilization of biomass from wet fenland sites and analysis of greenhouse gas abatement potentials resulting from the change in land use. Cost analysis includes approaches and cost estimates for planning, permission, management, and harvest of mixed vegetation, storage and transportation, and processing in innovative biomass utilization pathways. Labor times, costs, and potential savings from autonomous harvesting vehicles, among others, are identified. Reference uses and innovative business models are also considered to determine the economic viability of specific processes.

The aim of the project is to create a network of model and demonstration projects for the use of rewetted fens with representative fen areas, biomass utilization pathways and relevant actors in Brandenburg. Partners are in addition to ATB the Brandenburg State Office for the Environment (LfU), the University for Sustainable Development Eberswalde (HNEE), the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF) and the Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences (GFZ). The WetNetBB network is part of a network of model and demonstration projects (PaludiNet) coordinated by the Thünen Institute (TI) and Greifswald Moor Centrum (GMC) as PaludiCenter. The position is assigned to the Technology Assessment Department at the ATB, and close cooperation with the Systems Process Engineering Department is intended. 

Yourtasks

- Development of models for calculating the economic potential of different utilization systems on wet fenlands
- Recording and analysis of the labour time requirements of novel forms of use of wet fenlands
- Quantitative and qualitative evaluation of scientific results
- Development of scenario-based calculations of the costs of agricultural use through paludiculture on lowland bog sites
- Presentation of project results at scientific conferences and stakeholder meetings
- Writing of scientific publications and project reports

Your qualifications

- Very good university degree in agricultural economics or related subjects (Diploma or Master of Science)
- Knowledge and experience in economic analysis of agricultural systems
- Knowledge in statistical data analysis
- Strong interest in interdisciplinary collaboration
- Very good knowledge of written and spoken English
- Very good knowledge of German for communication with stakeholders and farmers
- Ability to work in a team and willingness to cooperate, reliability, flexibility, personal commitment and independent working skills
- EU driving license class B desirable

We offer

- Encouragement and support for PhD candidates in pursuing their doctoral studies in collaboration with partner universities
- An attractive, research-intensive, and interdisciplinary working environment
- A varied position at the interface of science and practice
- Excellent infrastructure for scientific work
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Participation in the VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The part-time position (30 hours/week) is initially limited to 4 years. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade E 13.

For further information, please contact Dr. Andreas Meyer-Aurich (phone +49 331 5699-222) and visit our website at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

Have we piqued your interest? Then apply by 30 September 2026 with your cover letter, CV (without photo), and employment references and/or contact details of referees via our online application portal for this job posting (reference number 2026-TA-3) at www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies (http://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies) . 

As a certified family-friendly institute, the ATB is committed to equal opportunities and diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnic or social background, age, religion, disability, or sexual identity. Applications from people with severe disabilities are particularly encouraged and will be given preference in the event of equal qualifications.

The ATB aims to increase the proportion of women among doctoral researchers and therefore explicitly encourages applications from women.

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Electrical Drive & Controls Engineer, you'll help bring our solar thermal technology to life by developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining the electrical drive and control systems behind our innovative collector technology.

Working alongside Mechanical, Structural and Software Engineers, you'll play a hands-on role in building prototypes, developing test benches, integrating electrical hardware with control software, and validating new solutions before they are deployed in industrial-scale projects.

Your Impact

The systems you build and test will directly improve the reliability, performance, and efficiency of GlassPoint's solar thermal technology.

By combining practical engineering with close collaboration across disciplines, you'll help ensure our innovations perform reliably in the laboratory, during testing, and ultimately in the field.

What You'll Do

Build & Integrate Electrical Systems

- Support the development and integration of electrical drive systems for our solar thermal technology.
- Install, wire, commission, and maintain electrical and control components for prototypes and engineering test benches.
- Troubleshoot electrical systems and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Support Controls & Software Development

- Work closely with software and controls engineers to develop and validate drive and control systems.
- Integrate electrical hardware with control software for prototypes and test benches.
- Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of drive and control systems during testing.

Develop and Maintain Test Systems

- Design, build, install, and maintain electrical systems for engineering test benches supporting the development and validation of our solar thermal components and subsystems.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve technical challenges.
- Support prototype assembly, commissioning, and field testing where required.
- Contribute to technical documentation, engineering standards, and continuous product improvement.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys getting hands-on with hardware and solving practical engineering challenges. You like building, wiring, testing, troubleshooting, and continuously improving electrical systems, and you're comfortable working both in the workshop and alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.

- Hands-on experience wiring, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validating electrical equipment and test systems.

- Complex engineering challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- A highly collaborative environment where your work moves quickly from concept to real-world application.

- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.
